section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the design of a single study examining associations between positive body image (operationalized along four dimensions including body appreciation, authentic body pride, body acceptance by others, and body image flexibility) and sexual outcomes. The study sampled both women and men from an online US adult community sample (avoiding reliance on college students), measured sexual liberalism through multiple indices, and controlled for sexual orientation and relationship status in analyses.
